title: Refuse a report folder that is no longer there
body:
Fixes the clean-up of a report folder that was moved: it is refused with `MISSING <folder>` and exit 2, rather than find's error and exit 1, so the scheduled run tells a moved folder from a failed one.

## Upgrade note

None.

## Validation

Siblings: searched `remove_old_reports` across `tools/`; it has no other caller, so there is nothing else to fix.
